title: Animation / Overview

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content-area capture; visible default tab states

slide_intent: Choose motion for its communicative job so viewers can follow progress and meaning without unnecessary distraction.
strategic_value: A deliberate balance of efficient and expressive movement can make IBM animation feel both precise and human.
demonstration: The webpage combines an introductory film frame, a four-part approach table, a productive/expressive diagram poster and links to illustration and interface applications. The PNG records still states.
practical_value: Decide whether a moment should prioritize efficient response or expressive emphasis, then judge the animation against clarity, brevity and restraint.

content_islands.name: Introduction and film
content_islands.spec: Place the communication rationale above the wide dark introductory film frame.

content_islands.name: Approach
content_islands.spec: Follow with Effective, Concise, Simple and Engineered rows, each explaining the intended behavior.

content_islands.name: Productive and expressive
content_islands.spec: Pair the blue geometric diagram poster with Types, Harmony and Tone text distinguishing the two motion roles.

content_islands.name: Applications
content_islands.spec: Finish with a server illustration and links to line, flat and isometric styles, then a laptop-interface example and the Motion in UI resource card.

reference_purposes.Intent: The opening and approach table explain that animation should guide understanding, respect attention and amplify meaning.
reference_purposes.Application: The source distinguishes productive efficiency from expressive energy and gives task-confirmation and process-beginning examples.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source excludes needless flourishes and overcomplicated action without clear reason, and explicitly says there is no single formula for motion.

ingredient.name: Productive and expressive motion
ingredient.role: Balance efficient response with meaningful emphasis.
ingredient.application: Choose the motion role for the message, then combine the roles where their contrast helps; animate only what serves understanding.
ingredient.scope: IBM animation guidance across formats. The PNG is a still capture; the source text, rather than a single frame, establishes behavioral guidance.

inspection.method: Six uniformly spaced sampled frames across the complete clip
